facts.description: The assessed services of the assessed office constitute at least one regulated activity under the referenced Ordinance after applicable regulated-activity carve-outs have been resolved. The Type 9 intra-group carve-out does not automatically resolve other activity types.; units: truth value
facts.name: services_are_regulated

facts.description: The assessed office is carrying on a business in providing those same services. Supply through case-specific judgment considering occupation or duty requiring attention, continuity, capacity for profit and profit purpose, without treating the list as an exhaustive conjunction. Retain the genuine single-family arrangement, reimbursement, profit-objective and ordinary-course qualifications; unresolved wording or evidence leaves this fact unknown.; units: truth value
facts.name: services_provided_as_business

facts.description: The same business providing the assessed services is carried on in Hong Kong, as determined from the circumstances. This is not merely the location of clients, shared premises or an unrelated business.; units: truth value
facts.name: business_carried_on_in_hong_kong

interpretations.statement: Unreviewed interpretation: [TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] The stated three-factor antecedent is satisfied exactly when the assessed services constitute at least one regulated activity, the office provides those same services as a business, and that same business is carried on in Hong Kong. True means all three supplied classifications hold; it is not a complete licensing or exemption verdict.
